name: vitalreit
description: vitalreit.com: Strapi CMS (/cms) and Next.js site (/web). Scripts only; each app has its own dependencies.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix cms install && npm --prefix web install
scripts.lint: npm --prefix cms run lint && npm --prefix web run lint
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix cms run typecheck && npm --prefix web run typecheck
scripts.build: npm --prefix cms run build && npm --prefix web run build
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build
